summary: This table presents an overview of key employee metrics for three quarters ending on September 30, 2023, June 30, 2024, and September 30, 2024. It includes total employees, software professionals, sales and support staff, voluntary attrition percentage, and the percentage of women employees. Notably, total employees increased from 328,764 in September 2023 to 317,788 in September 2024, while the percentage of women employees remained relatively stable around 39%. The voluntary attrition percentage shows a slight decrease from 14.6% in September 2023 to 12.9% in September 2024, indicating improved employee retention.
